title: usage-ledger.jsonl (append-only cost & usage ledger, one JSON object per line)

format.rewrite: never: a line is appended once and never edited, reordered or compacted (rotation would be a P1 concern and is NOT implemented)
format.write: one writeSync per record on an O_APPEND descriptor, so two processes cannot interleave a line
format.idempotencyKey: (session, turn_id, step, attempt) — a key already booked is skipped, not rewritten
format.grain: one row per model STEP (kind ok|error) plus one turn_total row per turn
format.noBodyRule: a row never contains prompt/message text, tool arguments or credentials; only counters, ids, names and prices

kinds.ok: a response arrived; usage is the provider's own counters (or null when the provider sent no usage frame, then billed_unknown=true)
kinds.error: the step failed (non-2xx / timeout / torn stream); usage carries the counters observed before the failure, or null
kinds.turn_total: the summary row of one turn: Σ of its step rows (token equality with the details is an assertion, §3.4 C2)

price.description: the snapshot THIS row was priced with (a frozen copy, not a reference)

turn.description: turn number parsed from turn_id; null = a call outside a driven turn (worker/summarizer)

step.description: 1-based step index within the turn; (turn, step) is strictly increasing

attempt.description: 0 = first attempt; retries/fallbacks increment (§5.2). P0 writes 0

provider.description: providers.json row id of the target

billed_unknown.description: true = no usage frame arrived: the cost is UNKNOWN, never 0

retryable.description: W723 LlmError.retryable; null = not structurally known (mid-stream)

cost.description: null when unpriced or unbilled — NOT a zero

fallback_from.description: target name this attempt fell over from (capability 4, P1)

steps.description: step rows contributing to this turn

usage.description: Σ of the contributing rows' usage (token equality asserted)

cost.description: Σ over the PRICED rows; see cost_complete

cost_complete.description: false = at least one row was unpriced or unbilled, so total is a floor, not the whole cost

outcome.description: the turn's terminal state (the log's own turn_end outcome)
